lastCompletedStory.title: Non-convergence hard terminal: maxRounds=3 and auditor-no-APPROVE both terminate cleanly

nextStoryContext: US-006 adds the non-convergence hard terminal to loop.ts. The fix: in the review branch, after writePrd(updatedPrd) re-read, check if roundsCompleted >= maxRounds && lastVerdict !== 'CLEAN'. If so: promote lastVerdict to MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT, writePrd again, notify orchestrator, emit review-verdict-handback event, call notifyTerminal('complete'), return { status: 'complete', ... }. The return is immediate (NOT continue) to prevent a (maxRounds+1)-th fix dispatch. DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS is now exported from decide.ts (was previously unexported const). The seam US-007 keys on: prd.review.lastVerdict === 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT' in prd.json. The oracle test file is test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts (5 tests, all pass). US-007 (escalation) should hook on the MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT verdict in prd.json to notify the operator.
